sections.label: PARF rebate lowered for EVs
sections.summary: Lowered PARF rebate and reduced rebate cap from $60,000 to $30,000 as EVs make early deregistration incentives less needed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: With electric vehicles (EVs) becoming more commonplace, there is now less of a need to encourage early deregistration through the PARF rebate.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: This is why we lowered the PARF rebate and also reduced the rebate cap from $60,000 to $30,000.

sections.label: Affected car buyers estimated
sections.summary: Fewer than 2,000 car buyers with committed purchases are estimated to be affected, mostly higher-end internal combustion engine car buyers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: Fewer than 2,000 car buyers with committed purchases are estimated to be affected.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: These include mostly buyers of higher-end internal combustion engine cars.
